import argparse

import re

import torch

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def set_seed(seed):
    random.seed(seed)
    np.random.seed(seed)
    torch.manual_seed(seed)
    torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)


def _extract_boxed(text):
    idx = text.rfind("\\boxed{")
    if idx == -1:
        return None
    depth = 0
    start = idx + len("\\boxed{")
    for i in range(start, len(text)):
        if text[i] == "{":
            depth += 1
        elif text[i] == "}":
            if depth == 0:
                return text[start:i]
            depth -= 1
    return None


def normalize_math_answer(s):
    if s is None:
        return None
    s = s.strip()
    s = re.sub(r"\\text\{([^}]*)\}", r"\1", s)
    s = re.sub(r"\\(mathrm|mathbf|textbf|operatorname)\{([^}]*)\}", r"\2", s)
